as_told.title: Kissinger's knowledge of US government UFO materials

plain: The president of Kalmykia, a small republic inside Russia, says he once sat down with two famous statesmen to talk about his own encounter with aliens. They were Henry Kissinger, the former US Secretary of State, and Mikhail Gorbachev, the last leader of the Soviet Union. The president, named Kiran Ilum Xenov, tells this himself. He sets it in the late 1990s, in a sauna at his home in Moscow. He says Kissinger suddenly asked him, "Well, how was it?" Gorbachev, sitting beside Kissinger, then said, "Come on, Henry, tell him. You should tell him everything." From their talk, Xenov says, he understood that Kissinger was "very familiar with the materials" on UFOs held by the US President's office, the CIA or NASA. Michels also tells the story, passing on what the president told him: that he met Gorbachev and Kissinger and was asked how it had been. If true, it would mean that men at the very top of both superpowers knew about such encounters.
